reading_check.as_frozen: CONNECT-0 R2 refused the table: the file reads 94.76 for the EU-27 in 2025 and the bar was 'rounds to 94.7'
reading_check.first_amendment: CONNECT-0A, set after the value was seen, also read not met (its claim to be known met was false; corrected there)
reading_check.accepted_under: CONNECT-0B, committed before its comparison: the publisher's article names the 2 highest members (Netherlands, Luxembourg, 99), the 2 lowest (Croatia 88, Greece 89) and the largest ten-year increase (Bulgaria, 34); the file gives each. 4 of 4 items held
reading_check.what_it_does_not_test: the household-type selection: a page figure cannot tell 'all households' (94.76) from 'two adults' (94.64). The selection rests on the file's label TOTAL

notes: no change over time is computed across a break in series (series_segment increments at each break)
regional rows carry different latest years; 316 of 349 regions have 2025
national rows of the regional file are not written; use the country table
K1 counts a home online by a shared phone; it is not a fixed line and not a host that is on
do not join this column with ITU's or the ACS's without stating the denominator

verdict.reason: tables of priors; a reading check, not a score
